notes: Refined existing stories for clarity, tightened contracts, and ensured clean separation of responsibilities without adding scope.

change_log.value: Clarified inclusion of TTL policy and required fields (generated_at, build_id, file_hashes) as enforceable contract
Explicitly separates TTL expiry vs hash drift detection as independent validation checks
Clarified trigger points include dev_pipeline and Brain execution entrypoints
Standardized response contract fields: freshness_state, age_seconds, drift_detected, last_generated
Expanded to explicitly cover pipeline gating and Brain runner enforcement scenarios

stories.title: Manifest Snapshot Metadata Schema
stories.description: Define and standardize manifest snapshot metadata contract including generated_at timestamp, build_id, file_hashes (SHA-256), and configurable freshness TTL policy used for validation prior to execution.

stories.title: Snapshot Freshness Validation Engine
stories.description: Implement validation logic that independently evaluates (1) TTL expiry based on generated_at and policy, and (2) hash drift by comparing stored file_hashes against current file state using manifest_generator hashing behavior.

stories.title: Auto-Regeneration Trigger on Stale Manifest
stories.description: Integrate freshness validation into execution entry points (dev_pipeline and Brain execution flows) and trigger manifest regeneration when TTL expiry or hash drift is detected, leveraging existing brain_snapshot and manifest generation processes.

stories.title: Internal Freshness Status Interface
stories.description: Provide an internal interface exposing standardized freshness status (freshness_state, age_seconds, last_generated, drift_detected) for Brain runner and DevOps flows to enforce pre-execution validation gates.

stories.title: Manifest Freshness Test Suite and Pipeline Integration
stories.description: Develop unit and integration tests covering TTL expiry, hash drift detection, regeneration triggers, and enforcement within Brain runner and pipeline execution paths, ensuring freshness gates block stale execution.
